facts: The diagnostic refuses incomplete, duplicate or failed experiment grids.
Training summary and checkpoint hashes, config/dataset bindings, frozen base hash/path, and paired initialization/sample-order identities are verified.
Effective LoRA update norms and differences versus same-seed no-teacher checkpoints use CPU float64 low-rank Gram traces without dense B@A products.
Only frozen q/v base projection tensors are read from the safetensors file, and no base weights are persisted.
Head parameter differences are reported separately from effective backbone differences.
Different selected optimizer steps are explicitly reported as a confound; numerical backend nondeterminism and lack of predictive-utility proof remain limitations.
Bound training/runtime/model sources and existing artifacts are unchanged by this implementation.

validation.inputs: synthetic CPU matrices, synthetic complete checkpoint grid, temporary safetensors
